verdict.rationale: Signifyd is an API-first SaaS service, so it can be driven headlessly. It has a REST API with per-team API-key Basic auth, an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, and both polling and webhook decision retrieval. For CI, isolation relies on test teams with their own keys, but these require contacting support, and there is no CLI, no sandbox base URL and no self-serve test mode. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI tooling, a self-serve sandbox or test mode with a separate endpoint, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
